trend_summary: Hyper-engaging 12-second wardrobe breakdown synchronized to a phonk or sped-up bass kick. Starts with an unfinished outfit hook, snaps through 7 rapid product layers, and ends on a hero silhouette turnaround with 3D zoom.
trending_audio_category: Sped-up Jersey Club / Brazilian Phonk / Lo-fi Trap Beat

pacing.cut_frequency: Every 0.45s on drop; 1.2s on opening hook
pacing.description: Intro holds for 1.2s for outfit preview, then drops into 0.45s rapid snap cuts matching each shoe/accessory kick drum.

scenes.visual_action: Creator stands with base layer, points directly at screen before doing a sudden heel stomp.
scenes.audio_cue: Bass riser building to first 808 drop
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: Apply "Camera Shake 2" keyframed to 100 intensity at 1.1s.

scenes.shot_type: Macro Close-Up on Footwear / Sneaker Box
scenes.visual_action: Quick unboxing kick or snap drop of retro sneakers onto clean rug.
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: Enable CapCut "Smart Motion Blur" set to 60 Blur, 4 Once.

scenes.visual_action: Hand smoothing heavy-weight denim pleats with natural fabric sound.
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: Add "Glitch Overlay 03" with 30% opacity on transition frame.

scenes.visual_action: Throwing hoodie over shoulders or pulling down zipper in one swift motion.
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: CapCut "Optical Flow" 2x speed ramp down to 0.5x.

scenes.visual_action: Adjusting vintage silver rings and misting fragrance towards lens.
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: Use "Retro Film Glow" preset with Soften: 45.

scenes.visual_action: Slow-motion 360 spin, hands in pockets, looking off-camera with relaxed posture.
scenes.audio_cue: Main Melody Chorus Drops with Heavy Reverb
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: Apply "Velocity Curve: Flash In" (Speed 1.5x down to 0.3x).

scenes.visual_action: Walking away towards sunset or concrete architecture, turns head back at camera at end frame to form seamless loop.
scenes.audio_cue: Reverb Tail Fade with Beat Loop back to Bar 1
scenes.capcut_preset_tip: Match the final walking frame with opening stance for 100% loop completion rate.

text_animation_style.font_recommendation: The Bold Font / Futura Heavy / Anton
text_animation_style.color_and_effects: Pure White with 40% Drop Shadow, 2px Solid Black Stroke, Lime Accent
text_animation_style.placement_tip: Safe zone: 35% from bottom, centered horizontally.

viral_hook_tactics: First 0.8s physical movement (heel stomp) resets viewer attention immediately
BPM-synchronized snap cuts prevent drop-off between seconds 2 and 6
Seamless loop cut makes 12-second video loop 2.2x on average, boosting algorithmic push
